title: Su Borek with Cheese Filling
subtitle: layered filo and cheese baked in an egg custard
description: Layers of filo dipped in an egg, oil and butter batter and filled with a mix of cheeses, cut into squares and baked until golden.

steps.text: Thaw the filo sheets in the fridge according to the packet instructions.
Preheat the oven to 180°C (conventional, no fan).
Beat the eggs well in a bowl. Add the water, oil, melted butter, salt and pepper and whisk to a uniform batter.
In a separate bowl, mix all the cheeses.
Grease a baking dish with a little olive oil and line it with 2 sheets of filo, pressing them into the edges.
Dip 2 filo sheets in the egg batter and lay them in the dish. Scatter a third of the cheese mixture over the pastry and cover with another sheet.
Dip 2 more sheets in the batter, place them in the dish, sprinkle over another third of the cheese, add another sheet and repeat for a third and final layer.
Press the layers down firmly, cut into squares with a sharp knife and pour the remaining batter over the top.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake for about 45 minutes, or until golden.
